entities.summary: David Chung OBE is a Malaysian-Papua New Guinean sports official. He served as President of the Papua New Guinea Football Association (PNGFA) from 2004 to 2018, as president of the Oceania Football Confederation (OFC) between 2011 and 2018, and was a member of the FIFA Council in 2017 and 2018.
